p: do them: For this doctrine stands not in bare knowledge, but in practice of life.
not add unto the word which: Think not to be more wise than I am.
diminish ought from it: God will not be served by halves, but will have full obedience.
eyes have seen what the LORD: God's judgments executed on other idolaters ought to serve for our instruction, read Nu 25:3,4.
cleave unto the LORD your God: And were not idolaters.
wisdom and your understanding in the: Because all men naturally desire wisdom, he shows how to attain it.
nigh unto them: Helping us, and delivering us out of all dangers, as in 2Sa 7:23.
keep thy soul diligently: He adds all these words, to show that we can never be careful enough to keep the law of God and to teach it to our posterity.
burned with fire unto the midst: The law was given with fearful miracles, to declare both that God was the author of it, and also that no flesh was able to abide the rigour of the same.
perform: God joins this condition to his covenant.
manner of similitude on the day: Signifying, that destruction is prepared for all who make any image to represent God.
divided unto all nations under the: He has appointed them to serve man.
iron furnace: He has delivered you out of most miserable slavery and freely chosen you for his.
ye shall go over: Moses good affection appears in that while he himself is deprived of such an excellent treasure, he does not envy those who must enjoy it.
consuming fire: To those that come not to him with love and reverence, but rebel against him.
corrupt yourselves: Meaning by this all superstition and corruption of the true service of God.
call heaven and earth to witness: Though men would abuse you, yet the insensible creatures will be witnesses of your disobedience.
scatter you among the nations: So that his curse will make his former blessings ineffectual.
heart and with all thy soul: Not with outward show or ceremony, but with a true confession of your faults.
sware unto them: To certify to them even more the assurance of their salvation.
ask from the one side of: Man's negligence is partially the cause for his ignorance of God.
temptations: By so manifest proofs that none could doubt of it.
know that the LORD he is: He shows the reason why God did these miracles.
he loved thy fathers: Freely, and not because they deserved it.
go well with thee: God promises reward not for our merits, but to encourage us, and to assure us that our labour will not be lost.
testimonies: The articles and points of the covenant.
the sea of the plain: That is, the salt sea.
